verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-configurable automations, scheduled jobs, triggers, or recurring background workflows that a user can set up in Zep. The closest item is Zep's own incremental thread-summary generation, which is internal processing rather than a user-defined automation. It is an adjacent behavior and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
